Seznamy.Napoveda: Adds the JaD class spell lists to the dnd5e spell list registry.

Jednotky.Napoveda: When a scene without a sáh grid is opened, offers the GM to convert it to 1 sáh per square.

Mince.Napoveda: Renames dnd5e gold, silver and copper pieces to the Czech JaD coins. Conversion rates stay the same.

Predmety.Napoveda: Weapon, armor, tool and focus choices (starting equipment, proficiencies) offer items from the JaD Items compendium instead of the English dnd5e items.

Radky.Napoveda: Encumbrance is counted in Rows as in JaD: light up to 5 + Str mod, medium up to 10 + Str mod (speed −1 sáh), with a backpack heavy up to 15 + Str mod (−3 sáhy). Applies to all sheets.

Zjednodusena.Napoveda: No encumbrance levels: a character carries 15 + Str mod Rows without penalty, but no more. Heavy armor without the required Strength slows by 2 sáhy.

ScenyVSazich.Napoveda: Newly created scenes get a grid of 1 square = 1 sáh, so token movement measurement matches character speeds in sáhy.

Midi.Aktivni: Jeskyně a draci: Midi-QOL is active – repeat saves and end-of-turn damage (OverTime) are automated.

Jednotky.Dotaz: Scene “{scena}” has a grid of {mrizka} per square. JaD characters have speed in sáhy and token movement measurement compares speed with grid units. Convert the scene to 1 sáh per square?
Jednotky.Prevedeno: Scene “{scena}” now has a grid of 1 sáh per square.
